name: WIZ
author: Addicting Games
description: Wiz is a free puzzle-platform game. Rogues are unpredictable, fighters are one-note, bards are always ruining parties, and paladins are too preachy. But Wizards! Wizards are the way to go. Wizards are fun, and Wiz is the funnest wizard of them all. Join Wiz in his game -- Wiz-- where he tries to unlock the secrets of the universe and move obstacles out of his way in order to get back home. Where his heart is. Because he left his heart there. Wiz is one of the pest puzzle style platform games you can play for free on your desktop right now. Use your fingers to swipe the various bricks out of the way and then charge your way toward the exit. It is a fun and fast game that can be played by anyone with a willingness to embrace the magic and majesty of Wiz, the wizard who loves to solve puzzles, move forward and exist entirely in two dimensions.
